title: Paranormal expert John Zaffis to visit SUNY Canton
excerpt: SUNY Canton College Activities Board is launching a series of Halloween events this month, featuring a presentation by paranormal investigator John Zaffis on October 22, a student lock-in on October 24, and a community trunk-or-treat on October 30.
content:
Gene Morse

Updated Wed, October 21, 2026 at 5:08 PM UTC

CANTON, N.Y. (WWTI) – The SUNY Canton College Activities Board (CAB) is launching a spooktacular lineup of Halloween festivities this month, headlined by a guest appearance from one of the world’s foremost authorities on hauntings and ghostly phenomena.

Renowned paranormal investigator John Zaffis will kick off the college's celebrations at 7 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 22, in the Kingston Theater, located inside the Richard W. Miller Campus Center. With over 40 years of experience and thousands of cases under his belt, Zaffis brings a wealth of eerie expertise to campus.

Television audiences may recognize Zaffis as the star of SyFy’s Haunted Collector and from Discovery Channel documentaries such as A Haunting in Connecticut and Little Lost Souls. He has also made prominent appearances on popular paranormal shows including Unsolved Mysteries, Ghost Hunters, and Ghost Adventures.

The presentation is free and open to the public. Immediately following his talk, Zaffis will lead an exclusive ghost hunt for 50 lucky students.

The spooky excitement continues over the weekend with CAB’s annual Halloween Lock-In, scheduled from 6 p.m. to 10 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 24, in the Miller Campus Center. SUNY Canton students and their guests can look forward to an evening packed with food, refreshments, giveaways, and seasonal activities, including:

  • A costume contest

  • A murder mystery game

  • A haunted house and staircase

  • An escape room challenge

  • Pumpkin decorating

To wrap up the Halloween season, the SUNY Canton Early Childhood program will host its annual “Trunk or Treat” event from 6 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30. Held in Parking Lot 5 near French Hall (with a rain location planned in Dana Hall), this free, family-friendly event invites local children from the surrounding community to collect treats in a safe and festive environment.
